issue.title: Dronecode SDK Windows build binary for Python package
issue.body:
@JonasVautherin This issue is just to track the progress.
So the goal is to have a prebuilt Windows binary which should then help the python library for Windows because the end-user doesn't want to build the C++ code in Visual Studio himself just to use the Python SDK.

I followed https://sdk.dronecode.org/en/contributing/build.html for Windows to build the library. With the folders for curl directly hacked into the cmake script here https://github.com/Dronecode/DronecodeSDK/blob/531a55b9c0ac9ea7a2dbaa5b17cd67c3f62316f8/cmake/curl.cmake#L8 because the IDE handles cmake automatically. After adding a what seems missing include it builds successfull.

issue.title: Reorganize deps

repository.name: MAVSDK
repository.description: API and library for MAVLink compatible systems written in C++ 20

issue.body:
This is moving the dependencies out of the project and adding them using `find_package` instead. Because we still want to provide a way to compile the dependencies from sources, it is organized as follows:

```
- superbuild
    |
    --- third_party
    |
    --- src
```

The superbuild adds both. Note that `third_party` builds the dependencies at configure time. 

To be done before merging this PR:
- [x] Fix all CI scripts
- [x] Add build for iOS
- [x] Update documentation (by adding a Makefile showing how to use CMake)
- [x] Test iOS build with Swift SDK
- [ ] ~Add build for Android~
- [ ] ~Test Android build~

Resolves #718, resolves #703
